risk_if_not_implemented: Without System Generated Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Lack of oversight of internal controls (R-GV-6), Unreliable Assurance / Decision Information (R-GV-10), Loss of Investigative / Evidentiary Capability (R-IR-1), Delayed Containment / Increased Incident Impact (R-IR-2), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Monitoring Reporting
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to provide an event log report generation capability to aid in detecting and assessing anomalous activities.
compensating_control_1.justification: Monitoring Reporting (MON-06) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of System Generated Alerts (MON-04) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.justification: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Analysis & Triage (MON-05.2) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of System Generated Alerts (MON-04) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented.
